versions.author: Damir
versions.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph edge ["Edge"]
    user(["User"]) --> web["Web app"]
    n1("Cache")
  end
  subgraph core ["Core services"]
    api["API gateway"]:::core
    api --> orders["Orders"]:::domain
    db[("Primary DB")]
    orders --> db
    orders -.->|"events"| bus[("Kafka")]:::event-bus
  end
  web -->|"HTTPS Read-only"| api
  bus -.-> notify["Notifier"]:::service
  notify --> mail{{"Mail"}}
  web --> n1
  orders --> mail
